acceptanceCriteria: All current AR, ER, and DR documents are inventoried.
Current local status for each AR, ER, and DR is captured.
Current GitHub issue number, title, state, and labels are captured where available.
The audit does not mutate GitHub state.
notes: Capture source path, source ID, title, local status, GitHub issue number, GitHub issue state, GitHub labels, and target Airframe ID.
Treat local documentation as authoritative unless the System Engineer approves a GitHub-derived correction.
Record mismatches as migration diagnostics rather than silently normalizing them.
Evidence: Live GitHub issue state, titles, and labels were intentionally not queried in this pass.
Evidence: System Engineer approved the local audit on 2026-07-07.
rationale: The migration must preserve the current manual documentation state and identify local/GitHub drift before any state is rewritten.
